title: claimed_origin not independently verifiable → unverifiable_origin (NOT a forgery)

preconditions.comment: Importer cites a source message but provides no origin_event_hash or origin_author_proof_ref; reader cannot independently confirm the claim.

expected_outcome.reader_ui_must_show: Claimed origin cannot be independently verified
expected_outcome.design_note: `unverifiable_origin` is a property of the citation strength, NOT an accusation of forgery. Reader UI MUST distinguish 'unverifiable' from 'invalid signature'.
